events.name: SayToDone
events.probe:
ref rEa
ref rEb
float fD
float fH
float fA
float fK
float fX
float fV
Begin Function {rEa, rEb}
let fD := GameDaysPassed
let fH := GameHour
let fA := -1
let fK := -1
let fX := -1
let fV := 0
if IsFormValid rEa
  let fV := 1
  if IsReference rEa
    if rEa.IsActor
      let fA := rEa.GetAV Health
      let fK := rEa.GetKnockedState
      let fX := rEa.GetDead
    endif
  endif
endif
if IsFormValid rEb
  let fV := fV + 2
endif
if fV == 0
  SetFunctionValue ("0" + "|" + "0" + "|" + ($ fD) + "|" + ($ fH) + "|" + ($ fA) + "|" + ($ fK) + "|" + ($ fX))
elseif fV == 1
  SetFunctionValue ((GetFormIDString rEa) + "|" + "0" + "|" + ($ fD) + "|" + ($ fH) + "|" + ($ fA) + "|" + ($ fK) + "|" + ($ fX))
elseif fV == 2
  SetFunctionValue ("0" + "|" + (GetFormIDString rEb) + "|" + ($ fD) + "|" + ($ fH) + "|" + ($ fA) + "|" + ($ fK) + "|" + ($ fX))
elseif fV == 3
  SetFunctionValue ((GetFormIDString rEa) + "|" + (GetFormIDString rEb) + "|" + ($ fD) + "|" + ($ fH) + "|" + ($ fA) + "|" + ($ fK) + "|" + ($ fX))
endif
End
